Masked header sample of an official NFL Game Book.

Source: the official NFL Game Book of the Cincinnati Bengals at Atlanta Falcons game (2026 REG 9,
Bernabeu Stadium, Madrid), captured on a GitHub runner on 2026-11-19 with `pdftotext -layout`
(capture workflow `.github/workflows/availability-capture.yml`, run 44607921365).

The copyright notice is dropped and the officials' names are masked. Everything else is the
official header: the date, the two club names, the venue, the kickoff time, the game-day weather
and the roof and surface. This is the layout the runner really produces, and the parser is pinned
to it.
